item.name: Kitchen Cleaning Kit
item.location: Kitchen, storage location labeled Kitchen Cleaning Kit.
item.readyBeforeUse: The kit contains labeled approved cleaner, labeled approved sanitizer, clean cloths, a brush, and a dustpan.
item.readyForNextPerson: Bottles are closed and upright. Reusable tools are clean and dry. Clean cloths and other consumables are stocked. The kit is returned to its label.
item.ifNotReady: Do not substitute an unapproved product. Tell the Dominatrix.

problem.condition: A product is missing, empty, leaking, or unlabeled.
problem.response: Do not use or replace it with another product. Tell the Dominatrix.
Do not reuse a dirty cloth. Tell the Dominatrix.
